title: Bulk object tagging with Amazon S3 Batch Operations and AWS Step Functions
description: AWS Step Functions creates an Amazon S3 Batch Operations job with a generated manifest, polls it to the end, and publishes the result to Amazon SNS.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: An AWS Step Functions workflow calls Amazon S3 Control CreateJob through the AWS SDK integration. Amazon S3 generates the object list from a key prefix, so there is no manifest file to build, and the job tags every matching object.
The workflow waits, calls DescribeJob, and loops until the job reaches a final status. The loop is bounded and the state machine has a timeout.

A Choice state branches on the failed-task count. A job with zero failed tasks publishes a success message to Amazon SNS. Any other end publishes a message with the job ID and counts, and the execution fails.
The job role can tag only objects under one prefix, so a run with another prefix exercises the failure branch.
